facts.fact: The National Registration Bureau says its Community Death Registration exercise, in phase seven from 15 to 29 April 2024, registers all deaths from 2017 to date in order to remove deceased persons from the National ID database.
facts.system: National ID Outreach and Community Death Registration exercise

MWI.note: The death registration is a community exercise, and no digital civil register is named.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is given.
The ID outreach targets people turning 16; no number at birth is mentioned.
The document says nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is named.

facts.fact: The National Registration Bureau says national ID cards are still being issued, with first IDs for people turning 16 and replacements for lost or damaged cards, and that the expiry date of existing IDs is suspended to 1 January 2026.

MWI.note: A phased community registration drive, class outreach, noted and not assessed.
